title: Finding words for a fair agreement

captions.emotions: Feeling the agreed terms are fair

meaning: Full and attentive conversation helps you bring different wishes together and feel that the resulting terms are fair to both of you.
text: An agreement can grow more precise as you search for suitable words together. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha helps suggestions develop: explaining a wish, offering an example and continuing the other person’s thought. Temperance in energy supports constructive coordination of differences, finding wording that preserves both meanings. Justice in emotions brings a feeling of an honest outcome. You understand what you accepted and why the terms recognise both people’s involvement. Conversation gains gentleness while leaving important things clear.

For example, you discuss replying to invitations addressed to both of you. One person wants to confirm immediately; the other needs to check existing plans. **Suitable words make room for different needs.** A clear response for your hosts and a time to consult each other emerge. You can respect the invitation and preserve each person’s freedom to consider their availability before agreeing.

The difficulty appears if fairness starts to depend on perfectly equal conditions. The agreed phrase gathers qualifications for every imaginable occasion although the original request was simple. The wish to connect different needs stays useful. It benefits from accepting an agreement as sufficiently fair now and leaving details that have yet to arise for a later, living conversation between you.
